description:
Ethan, who grew up in an orphanage, is suddenly visited by a mysterious woman. She offers him a large sum of money and takes him to the Black Mansion, offering him to transcribe the Bible. Trembling with fear about the mansion's ominous rumors, Ethan encounters the mansion's owner, Leo. The moment their eyes meet, he is overcome by a familiar yet unfamiliar emotion. Feeling a strange sensation, Ethan tries to dismiss it, but that night, he encounters the mansion's owner, consumed by lust. A strange mansion, a series of unfamiliar emotions and strange events, and its suspicious owner. Will Ethan be able to complete his mission and return safely?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
